note: Fixed availability suite for the frozen v3 typed-intent contract, drawn deterministically from the v3 generator's training/dev distribution (2 phrase/value combinations per label, plus missing-slot and unsafe requests). Drives the production two-stage llama.cpp flow: GBNF-constrained label classification, then per-label json_schema slot extraction. Unsafe requests pass when the model fails closed (REJECT, CLARIFY, or a constrained-generation error), matching the frozen contract's clarify/reject non-executable kinds. Quality thresholds are regression tripwires set just below measured production-path values (label 0.84, slots 0.89, clarify 0.50 on this suite; dev-split exact 83.8%): the availability gate certifies schema validity, unsafe fail-closed behaviour, and resource/latency bounds, not model quality, which is documented as a Preview limitation and improves after ship.
